role: Discovery operational traces, online metrics, and linked campaign observability

integrations.notes: Generic traces, evaluations, experiments, and gates exist.

The cross-language telemetry vocabulary binds campaign, round, stage, evidence/claim class, budgets, counts, and authoritative receipt digests. Producer emission, a real public-retrospective trace, and a dedicated operator view are not yet proven.

limitations: Palette can ingest the generic Discovery attributes, but no real campaign trace or dedicated operator cockpit is included in this proof.
Palette experiments are software and agent evaluations, not authoritative wet-lab experiment records.
